0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: We have kept you waiting overlong, I fear...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000020_KRILE
1.description: Not to worry, Alphinaud. We had some rather fine mulled wine to keep us company. Truth be told, you could have delayed your arrival a few moments more...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000030_TATARU
2.description: Gibrillont got the spicing just right this time. His latest batch is not only delicious and warming, but <hex:021A020203>soothing to the humours<hex:021A020103>!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000040_YSHTOLA
3.description: Indeed. But 'twas not to soothe our humours that we gathered here.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000050_KRILE
4.description: Ah, no─quite right. The matter of that poor dragoon...

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000060_ALPHINAUD
5.description: You have discovered something─a means to save him?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000070_KRILE
6.description: Let us not jump to conclusions, shall we? Assess the facts presented, then make an educated analysis, as you were taught.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000080_YSHTOLA
7.description: Pray cast your mind back to the moment of Estinien's transformation. Do you recall how you described it to us?

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000090_YSHTOLA
8.description: You spoke of the sudden pangs which racked his body when he took up both of Nidhogg's eyes─and of how his form was twisted thereafter into a shadowy semblance of the great wyrm.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000100_ALPHINAUD
9.description: When he appeared at Falcon's Nest, the wyrm's eyes were fused to his mail.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000110_YSHTOLA
10.description: Would that only his armor had been corrupted... Snaking forth from the eyes, I descried dark tendrils which entangled his very being. His aether has been all but smothered.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000120_ALPHINAUD
11.description: Then he is lost to us forever?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000130_KRILE
12.description: What did I just say about jumping to conclusions!? Y'shtola clearly stated “all but smothered.”

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000140_KRILE
13.description: As I later discovered, her impression matched my own. Though Nidhogg's presence filled my mind's eye, beneath his seething aura, I sensed the merest hint of something else.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000150_KRILE
14.description: And after listening to Y'shtola's observations, I became more certain of my suspicion: that the “something else” I had sensed was, in fact, the trace of a different will, submerged in the sea of Nidhogg's rage.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000170_YSHTOLA
16.description: Yes. 'Tis like that Estinien's spirit yet lingers.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000180_ALPHINAUD
17.description: Can we not wrest him from Nidhogg's grasp, then!? Tear the eyes from the armor!?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000190_YSHTOLA
18.description: We know not if that would serve to separate wyrm's soul from man's. None have ever attempted such a feat.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000200_ALPHINAUD
19.description: Should it offer even the faintest hope of success, then by the gods, I shall be the first to try.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000220_KRILE
21.description: By all means, hold fast to your hope. But be mindful of the dangers.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000230_KRILE
22.description: Even should you succeed in excising the eyes from the dragoon's mail, we have no way of knowing if your friend's soul would survive so violent a separation. And that is to say nothing of the possibility that his would-be savior might become Nidhogg's next host.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000240_ALPHINAUD
23.description: But what other choice remains to us? Should the opportunity present itself, I will tear those foul orbs from Estinien's armor and trust in the resilience of his soul─even at the risk of mine own!

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000250_HONOROIT
24.description: Ah! I've found you at last!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000260_HONOROIT
25.description: A messenger of the Temple Knights came to the manor some few hours past. The lord commander humbly requests the company of the Warrior of Light and Master Alphinaud.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000270_ALPHINAUD
26.description: Ser Aymeric would speak with us? Very well. Thank you, Honoroit.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000280_YSHTOLA
27.description: 'Twould seem duty calls. Pray see to yours, and we shall return to ours.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000290_ALPHINAUD
28.description: Thank you, Y'shtola, Krile. Your words have given me hope where there was none.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000310_KRILE
30.description: Alphinaud is allowing his feelings for this dragoon to cloud his thoughts. I worry he may do something rash. Keep an eye on him, would you?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000320_MIDGARDSORMR
31.description: They think more of their friend's deliverance than their foe's defeat... But will history commend their fealty or condemn their folly?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000330_EDMONT
32.description: The conference held at Falcon's Nest was to be a celebration of the reconciliation 'twixt man and dragon.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000340_EDMONT
33.description: But the lingering shade of Nidhogg, clad in the flesh of the Azure Dragoon,<hex:02100103>did mark the occasion by spilling the blood of his own kind.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000350_EDMONT
34.description: A timely atrocity to remind the children of Ishgard that the Dragonsong War was far from over...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000360_EDMONT
35.description: And when fear gave way to fury, the call to arms rang out anew: “Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!”

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000370_AYMERIC
36.description: My friends, I thank you for coming.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000380_ALPHINAUD
37.description: You have had news of Nidhogg?

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000390_AYMERIC
38.description: Alas, not. Our scouts range far and wide, but they have as yet found no trace of the great wyrm.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000400_LUCIA
39.description: We dispatched an elite unit of dragoons to reconnoiter the Churning Mists, but even they returned empty-handed.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000420_AYMERIC
41.description: Fear not, Alphinaud─we shall see the wyrm again soon enough. His words at Falcon's Nest attest to that.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000430_AYMERIC
42.description: Indeed, he is like to come sooner than we would wish.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000440_ALPHINAUD
43.description: I assume Ishgard's defenses are being bolstered as we speak?

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000450_AYMERIC
44.description: With all haste. I mean to call upon every able-bodied warrior at our disposal, from the knights of the four houses to the men and women of the watch.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000460_AYMERIC
45.description: But I did not summon you to discuss strategy.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000470_ALPHINAUD
46.description: What then would you have of us, my lord?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000480_AYMERIC
47.description: I will speak plain: now that Nidhogg is possessed of both of his eyes, no mortal force we can muster will repel him. That being the case, we must needs recruit an ally of equal strength...

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000500_AYMERIC
49.description: I do. To whom else could we turn?

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000510_ALPHINAUD
50.description: That he is Nidhogg's equal I do not deny. Nor can I name another. But convincing the reclusive creature to do battle with his own brood-brother will be... How shall I put this?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000520_AYMERIC
51.description: It will be no small undertaking, yes. Estinien's report was most particular about Hraesvelgr's unwillingness to involve himself in the affairs of men.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000530_AYMERIC
52.description: But much has changed since your visit to Sohm Al, and if there is even a chance that the dragon may be swayed, I <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> plead our case. Whatever price the dragon asks of me, I shall pay it─such was my oath to defend the people of Ishgard.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000540_AYMERIC
53.description: Come what may, my friends, the battle with Nidhogg will mark the end of my tenure as the acting head of church and state. Will you help me discharge this final duty?

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000550_ALPHINAUD
54.description: We will, my lord─though I fear our involvement offers no guarantee of success.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000560_ALPHINAUD
55.description: Come, then─we will depart at your leisure.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000580_AYMERIC
57.description: The city is yours, First Commander.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000590_LUCIA
58.description: My lord. We shall pray for your swift return.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000600_HRAESVELGR
59.description: You dare summon me again, mortals?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000610_ALPHINAUD
60.description: Great Hraesvelgr, 'tis not lightly that we beg this audience. Pray hearken to our words, for they concern the future of man and dragon both.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000620_AYMERIC
61.description: Greetings, Hraesvelgr. I am Aymeric de Borel, acting ruler of the nation of Ishgard.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000630_AYMERIC
62.description: I am come before you to parley on behalf of my people.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000640_HRAESVELGR
63.description: ...To <hex:021A020203>parley<hex:021A020103>? Thinkest thou thy purpose unclear to me? Thou art come to beg mine aid in the battle against the shade of my brood-brother.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000660_HRAESVELGR
65.description: I but read that which is writ plain in thine eyes. Would that thou had wit enough to scry the answer in mine.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000670_HRAESVELGR
66.description: My beloved Shiva did once build a bridge 'twixt man and dragon─a bridge which thy treacherous forefathers saw fit to tear down, as thou well knowest.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000680_HRAESVELGR
67.description: Thinkest thou Nidhogg was alone in despairing at the murder of our brood-sister? Thinkest thou mine own soul did not cry out for vengeance? Know then that upon that accursed day, my heart did wither in my breast, and thy kind become unto me the harbingers of despair.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000690_HRAESVELGR
68.description: 'Tis only Shiva's gentle dream that preventeth me from flying at Nidhogg's shoulder. Be grateful that I swore to abjure aggression ere I consumed her.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000700_HRAESVELGR
69.description: I permit my children to offer or deny thee aid as they see fit; to warn thy people of my brood-brother's coming. That thou wouldst dare ask more of me but affirmeth thine incurable arrogance.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000710_ALPHINAUD
70.description: We understand that in your despair at man's betrayal, you seek only the refuge of solitude.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000720_ALPHINAUD
71.description: But despite your protestations of spent faith, do you not still nurture the smallest flame of hope?

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000730_HRAESVELGR
72.description: Perceivest thou such light in the dusk of mine existence?

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000740_ALPHINAUD
73.description: I do. If you claim I see falsely, then tell me: why did you consent to bear Ysayle upon your back?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000750_HRAESVELGR
74.description: Ysayle... Piteous, deluded Ysayle. The child did lament her past sins, and sought to balance the scales with her remaining days. 'Twas her unquenchable passion, so alike to that of my beloved, which did spur me into flight.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000760_HRAESVELGR
75.description: And for mine own part, I would countenance no longer the hands of evil men to use my brood-brother's eye for ill.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000770_ALPHINAUD
76.description: So you do distinguish between those who acknowledge and repent their sins, and those who perpetuate them. Interesting.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000780_ALPHINAUD
77.description: It seems to me that you have not, in fact, lost faith in mankind as a whole. Rather, you weigh our respective merits by how we allow the past to influence our future.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000790_HRAESVELGR
78.description: Spare me thine idle sophistry. Even were there a mote of truth in thy reasoning, what of it? Wouldst thou have me slay mine own sibling to save a city of mortals?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000800_AYMERIC
79.description: Should we suffer ties of blood to bind our hands then? Nay. If the crime is one of unconscionable evil, we must needs condemn it─even should the transgressor be our closest kin.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000810_AYMERIC
80.description: When my father corrupted himself and his followers with the power of a primal, I beseeched the Warrior of Light to slay him─an act alike to patricide.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000820_AYMERIC
81.description: That he did not die by my hand matters little─if anything, it heaps greater disgrace upon my name. But had my father not fallen, he would have drawn countless thousands into a holy war of hellish proportions─which I hold the greater crime. Thus did I order his execution, sparing the lives of my people and yours.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000830_AYMERIC
82.description: Alas, your brother wyrm now prepares to murder those whom I sought to spare. What is more, he has taken my comrade's body for his own─but if I must slay my dearest friend to defeat my direst foe, I will not flinch from my duty!

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000840_HRAESVELGR
83.description: Thou wouldst strike down thy friend and, by example of thy righteousness, persuade me to break mine oath and kill my kindred?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000850_MIDGARDSORMR
84.description: Heed me, my child. The servants of Hydaelyn envision a different outcome. They intend salvation not only for Ishgard, but for the doomed dragonslayer as well.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000860_MIDGARDSORMR
85.description: Believest thou this shade to be Nidhogg returned? Is it not merely a manifestation of his vengeance─the shadow cast by thy brood-brother's rage? I would not command thee, but ponder well thy course lest it lead thee unto greater remorse...

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_A1_000_001
87.description: While this shade of vengeance remains, the future will ever be uncertain.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000870_HRAESVELGR
90.description: Nidhogg's transformation into rage incarnate is, in part, of mine own doing. I rendered unto him mine eye, and empowered his revenge thereby... But 'tis the purity of my brood-brother's wrath that lendeth him his all-surpassing might.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000880_HRAESVELGR
91.description: Thou wishest to rescue the dragoon from his fate along with all the rest? I do begin to see why Ysayle entrusted her hope unto thee. Thy purpose is pure. ...But so too is my brood-brother's wrath, and 'tis that which lendeth him his all-surpassing might.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000890_HRAESVELGR
92.description: What, no words for me, warrior? I take it thou art resolved to act whether I aid thee or no... Ha! I do admire thy determination.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000900_HRAESVELGR
93.description: Hast thou the strength of will to stand against so terrible a shadow, I wonder? 'Twould seem I must put thee and thy companions to the proof.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000910_HRAESVELGR
94.description: I shall await thee in the ruins wherein Ratatoskr once dwelled. Heed well the words of my children, and hasten thee to the place of thy trial!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000920_HRAESVELGR
95.description: Even bereft of an eye, my brood-brother was a fearsome foe indeed.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000930_HRAESVELGR
96.description: But having tasted thy strength firsthand, full well can I imagine how thou didst bring him low. The dread title of “Azure Dragoon” is no empty appellation.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000940_HRAESVELGR
97.description: But having tasted thy strength firsthand, I do begin to see how thou didst bring him low. Hydaelyn chooseth Her servants well.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000950_HRAESVELGR
98.description: Very well. I shall trust in the seed of man one last time. By thy deeds shall the flickering hope that lingereth yet within my heart be kindled anew...or extinguished forever.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000980_HRAESVELGR
101.description: That you yet stand is ready proof of your determination, mortals.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_000990_HRAESVELGR
102.description: Let us fight as allies, then, and together banish my brood-brother's vengeful shade. On my oath, the wrath that once was Nidhogg shall meet its end!

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001000_HRAESVELGR
103.description: This I swear on the memory of my beloved Shiva, and on the soul of lost Ysayle...

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001010_ALPHINAUD
104.description: Our negotiations proved rather more strenuous than I had anticipated, but the results seem well worth the effort.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001020_AYMERIC
105.description: The battle was indeed hard-won. Thank you, my friends─I would never have earned Hraesvelgr's cooperation had you not seen fit to grant me yours.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001030_AYMERIC
106.description: 'Twas your stalwart heroism that moved the heart of the great wyrm at the last. Any gratitude I can offer is but poor reward for your continued service to Ishgard.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001040_ALPHINAUD
107.description: 'Twould seem our final reckoning with the dread wyrm is at hand. I only wish we had some inkling as to when he means to strike.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001060_MIDGARDSORMR
109.description: The cry heraldeth his coming. Nidhogg's shade hath taken wing.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001070_AYMERIC
110.description: It has begun. We must away to Ishgard!

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001080_HRAESVELGR
111.description: Know you, then, what this roar portendeth?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001090_AYMERIC
112.description: Aye. I must return to my city without delay.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001100_HRAESVELGR
113.description: Then we shall lend you our wings. Let us meet with Nidhogg on the field of battle, and together bring an end to his wrathful song.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001110_LUCIA
114.description: Remember your training! We hold fast until the lord commander returns!

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001130_ARTOIREL
116.description: Reinforcements!<hex:02100103>By the Fury... That one is the size of Nidhogg!

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001150_ARTOIREL
118.description: You are late, Warrior of Light!

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001160_NIDHOGG
119.description: Wherefore standest thou with these vermin, Brother?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001180_HRAESVELGR
121.description: The suffering thou sowest serveth no end. The traitors' progeny have learned of their forefathers' betrayal, and seek now to make amends with our kind.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001190_HRAESVELGR
122.description: Never shall our grief be assuaged nor our loss forgotten, but reconciliation may yet halt the spread of this plague of enmity. Forsake thy vengeance and be at peace.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001200_NIDHOGG
123.description: What soft-headed ramblings are these? Thy dalliance with that vile maid hath robbed thee of thy wits! Mayhap her cloying perfume hath made thee forget the stench of our brood-sister's lifeblood!

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001210_HRAESVELGR
124.description: Thou darest speak thus of my beloved!?

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001220_NIDHOGG
125.description: Ah! So the flames of rage may yet be kindled! I feared thy heart's fire had long since gone out. But waste not thy fury on words, Brother─thou shalt have need of it for the battle!

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001240_NIDHOGG
127.description: Thou art weak, Hraesvelgr─a slithering wyrm who fawneth on the vermin who should rightly be his prey. For a thousand years have I fought without cease─and thou didst think to prevail against me!

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001250_HRAESVELGR
128.description: Glory not in thy victory, shade. The battle...is not yet won. My power─and my hope─have I entrusted to another...

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001260_NIDHOGG
129.description: Thine eye! What hast thou done!?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001270_NIDHOGG
130.description: Fool! Thou wouldst trust a mortal with thy strength!?

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001280_NIDHOGG
131.description: I know thee... 'Twas thou who didst intrude upon my lair and best the half of me. But now I am whole, and naught in creation shall deny me my vengeance!

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001300_ESTINIEN
133.description: (-Nidhogg-)Nay... I will not allow it... I am of the first brood... I am vengeance incarnate... I am Nidhogg!

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001320_ESTINIEN
135.description: This is not your hand, wyrm!

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001340_ESTINIEN
137.description: I would ask one last favor of you, Warrior of Light... Finish me─now, while I have the beast subdued!

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001380_ESTINIEN
141.description: You waste your time. Kill me! It is the only way! Ending Nidhogg...will be my final duty...

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001390_ALPHINAUD
142.description: No! You can't die like this! I won't let you!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001420_NIDHOGG
145.description: Undone by mortal will. Whither now...?

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001430_AYMERIC
146.description: The eyes! Cast them into the abyss!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001440_AYMERIC
147.description: He lives. Ah, Estinien, my ill-fated friend...

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001450_AYMERIC
148.description: Lucia! Summon the healers! I want them ready to receive him!

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001470_AYMERIC
150.description: Allow me to do this much, at least...

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001480_HRAESVELGR
151.description: The Horde have sensed the fall of their master, and scattered to the winds.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001490_AYMERIC
152.description: You have my gratitude, Hraesvelgr. Your deeds this day have saved a great many lives.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001500_HRAESVELGR
153.description: Then our alliance hath served its purpose.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001510_HRAESVELGR
154.description: Thou didst wield the power I granted thee well. 'Twas thine own skill and not mine eye which earned thee victory.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001520_HRAESVELGR
155.description: I wish thy companion a swift recovery. Fare you well, children of man.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001530_ALPHINAUD
156.description: The battle is won. We can do no more for Estinien now than bear him home and wish him well, even as Hraesvelgr did. The rest we must trust to the hands of the healers and the grace of the gods.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001540_EDMONT
157.description: The heroes of the hour return!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001550_ALPHINAUD
158.description: We but did our duty, my lord. It was the memories of fallen friends and not our heroism which saw us through at the last.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001560_ARTOIREL
159.description: I gave every onze of my strength, but mine efforts would have counted for naught had the Warrior of Light not arrived to challenge the great wyrm. As a sworn knight of Ishgard, I had hoped to do more for my city...

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001570_EMMANELLAIN
160.description: Well, we cannot <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> be heroes, dear brother. Let us put away our pride for a moment, and revel in the valiant deeds of our comrade! For your sterling service to Ishgard, we salute you!

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001580_EMMANELLAIN
161.description: And while we're on the subject of valiant deeds, I believe I myself have earned some small measure of recognition: under my watchful command, the ballistas of the outer ward struck down a veritable swarm of Dravanian invaders.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001590_HONOROIT
162.description: My lord's command was certainly watchful. He bravely watched as the siege crews took aim, and continued to watch as countless wyverns met their end. Indeed, the ward's defenders proved so well drilled that my lord had little occasion to <hex:021A020203>stop<hex:021A020103> watching.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001600_EDMONT
163.description: There will be time enough to determine who is most deserving of recognition later. Our friends are doubtless weary from their exertions.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001610_EDMONT
164.description: I had chambers prepared in expectation of your return. You are welcome to retire at your leisure.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001620_ALPHINAUD
165.description: I am most grateful for your hospitality, my lord, but I believe I shall pay a visit to the Temple Knights' infirmary. Pray excuse me.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001630_EDMONT
166.description: How Master Alphinaud has grown. The plight of his stricken brother-in-arms pains him more than his own hurts.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001640_EDMONT
167.description: ...In which respect, he has come to resemble you, Warrior of Light. Go then─visit the Azure Dragoon, and grant him what comfort you may.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001660_ESTINIEN
169.description: Cease your mewling, boy. It grates my ears.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001670_ALPHINAUD
170.description: Forgive me. When I saw you awaken, I could not─ It was such a relief! We feared you might never wake up!

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001680_AYMERIC
171.description: Now, now, Estinien. If Master Alphinaud thought any less of you, you would still be Nidhogg's plaything─<hex:021A020203>or dead<hex:021A020103>.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001700_ESTINIEN
173.description: I thank you, Alphinaud...and you too, Warrior of Light. Quite how you managed to persuade Hraesvelgr to aid in his brood-brother's downfall, I cannot imagine─but full glad am I that you did. 'Tis an honor to share the mantle of Azure Dragoon with one such as you.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001710_ESTINIEN
174.description: I thank you, Alphinaud...and you too, Warrior of Light. Quite how you managed to persuade Hraesvelgr to aid in his brood-brother's downfall, I cannot imagine─but full glad am I that you did. Yet again, you have achieved the impossible.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001720_AYMERIC
175.description: I, for my part, owe you an apology. When last we met, I did willingly loose an arrow at your heart. Can you forgive me?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001730_ESTINIEN
176.description: There is naught to forgive, Aymeric. You but acted in defense of Ishgard, as is your duty.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001740_ESTINIEN
177.description: Were you any less single-minded about it, I would not follow you into battle─nor trust you at my back.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001750_ESTINIEN
178.description: Besides, I had come to the selfsame conclusion─that I would have to perish for Nidhogg to be stopped. So let us dispense with the hand-wringing. I have heard enough mewling for one day.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001770_ESTINIEN
180.description: The tendrils of Nidhogg's foul presence bound up every fiber of my being, usurping my senses, but I yet retained some trace of awareness.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001780_ESTINIEN
181.description: The wyrm's mind was as a vast and tumultuous sea. Endlessly its black waters churned, his grief and despair at Ratatoskr's murder never calming, never receding. And driven by this surging current came wave upon wave of unrelenting rancor.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001790_ESTINIEN
182.description: It was the very image of my own heart. There I saw the dark reflection of the hatred I felt after Nidhogg slew my family, when no path remained save vengeance against dragonkind.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001800_ESTINIEN
183.description: Neither one of us had a choice. But I was blessed with something Nidhogg was not─comrades and teachers to console and admonish me.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001810_ESTINIEN
184.description: Had I not had them to gainsay my obsession, it would surely have consumed me, as Nidhogg's did him, and we would have been in all respects alike.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001820_ESTINIEN
185.description: Though his shade is banished, his spirit scattered upon the Sea of Clouds, I feel no joy at his passing. Where once I craved vengeance, I now crave rest.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001830_ESTINIEN
186.description: Lord Commander, my hunt is at an end. I would lay down the mantle of Azure Dragoon.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001850_ABEL
188.description: He has tired himself with too many words.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001860_ABEL
189.description: I doubt not that he will make a full recovery, but he must be allowed some few days of quiet.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001870_AYMERIC
190.description: I too must see my path to its end. Sleep well, my friend.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001880_EDMONT
191.description: Following the battle with Nidhogg on the Steps of Faith,<hex:02100103>Ser Aymeric called an assembly that he might make his final proclamation as acting head of state.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001890_EDMONT
192.description: 'Twas there, with one decree, that the thousand-year rule of the archbishops was ended, paving the way for a new republic.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001900_EDMONT
193.description: The governance of Ishgard would now be placed in the hands of high- and lowborn alike,<hex:02100103>their ranks represented by the newly founded House of Lords and House of Commons.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001910_EDMONT
194.description: Church was separated from state. The foundation for change had been carefully laid,<hex:02100103>and the reforms proposed by Ishgard's new government passed into law without incident.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001920_EDMONT
195.description: His duty done, Aymeric de Borel gladly stepped down from the archbishop's dais...<hex:02100103>only to be raised unto the highest seat in the House of Lords.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001930_EDMONT
196.description: Though he strove at first to refuse this honor,<hex:02100103>the unexpectedly strident voice of the Count de Durendaire left him little choice but to accept...

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001940_EDMONT
197.description: And so it was that the winds of gentle revolution came to stir.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001950_EDMONT
198.description: Prominent among the many honored guests at Ser Aymeric's investiture were the ambassadors of dragonkind,<hex:02100103>a fitting symbol of Ishgard's newfound peace.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001960_EDMONT
199.description: The people looked on in awe as he soared through the heavens on dragonback,<hex:02100103>and by their cheers did they hail him an Azure Dragoon for a new age.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001970_EDMONT
200.description: Thus were the notes of the Dragonsong rewritten, the din of war giving way to a rising litany of peace and hope.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03300_001980_SYSTEM
201.description: From the memoirs of Count Edmont de Fortemps<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Heavensward<hex:021A020103>
